questions.text: Describe a café or restaurant you like to go to.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a café or restaurant you like to go to. You should say: where it is; what kind of food or drink it serves; who you usually go there with; and explain why you like going there.

questions.text: Would you recommend this place to a visitor to your town?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you recommend this place to a visitor to your town?

questions.text: Why do people choose to eat out rather than eat at home?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a café or restaurant you like to go to, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all eating out. Why do people choose to eat out rather than eat at home?

questions.text: Is eating out more popular now than it was in the past?
